name: Sun Pharma
narrative: Management targeted high single-digit revenue growth for FY27, which aligns with H1 FY27 revenue growing 11% to ₹312,836 million. However, Q2 FY27 reported net profit diverged sharply, falling 36.2% year-on-year to ₹1,995 crore.

promises.statement: The acquisition of Organon is expected to close in six to nine months.

said.quote: Obviously this transaction is subject to approvals from Organon shareholders as well as the customary regulatory approvals and we expect this deal to close in about six to nine month time

actual_source.quote: We are now on track to close the transaction as per earlier communicated timelines, that is Q4 of FY27

promises.note: Reaffirmed in November 2026 to close as scheduled in Q4 FY27.

promises.statement: Management expects to complete the Organon acquisition in Q4 FY27.

said.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 of financial year '27 and an integration management office has been working on day one preparedness

actual_source.quote: We are now on track to close the transaction as per earlier communicated timelines, that is Q4 of FY27

promises.note: Management confirmed in Q2 FY27 that closing remains on track for Q4 FY27.

promises.statement: Management estimates cost synergies of around $350 million to materialize over two to four years.

said.quote: There are also significant potential synergies that could come out, which we have highlighted could be in the range of about $350 million which could be materialized in the next two to four years

promises.statement: The combined entity expects to generate free cash flows of $2.0 to $2.5 billion annually.

said.quote: Revenue and the EBITDA moving up by 2x and both the entities together generating free cash flows of close to $2 billion, $2.5 billion on an annual basis

promises.statement: The acquisition is expected to be EPS accretive from day one of closing.

said.quote: So we believe this will be EPS accretive from the beginning

promises.statement: Expect effective tax rate to remain in the range around 25%.

said.quote: I think it would be sort of in the range we guess

promises.statement: Post-acquisition net debt to EBITDA will be around 2.3x for the combined entity.

said.quote: However, if we look at the debt in context of the multiples of combined company EBITDA, then I think it's around 2.3 times, not very large by current standards of debt in other companies

promises.metric: Full year top line growth guidance
promises.statement: Management targets high single-digit revenue growth for the full year FY27.

said.quote: Think we should stick on to the high single-digit growth for the full year

cash.read: Profits reliably turn into cash. Over FY22 to FY26, cumulative operating cash flow of ₹52,570 crore exceeded total reported net profit of ₹43,986 crore.

bull.point: India formulations sales grew 17.3% year-on-year in Q2 FY27 to ₹55,523 million, continuing strong domestic market performance.

evidence.quote: The sales of India formulations were INR55,523 million for the quarter, recording a growth of 17.3%

bull.point: Consolidated net cash balance stood strong at $3.3 billion as of Q2 FY27.

evidence.quote: Balance sheet continues to be strong with a net cash of USD3.3 billion at the consolidated level

bull.point: Operating cash flow totaled ₹52,570 crore over FY22–FY26, fully covering reported cumulative net profit of ₹43,986 crore.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹52,570 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹43,986 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Reported net profit after tax dropped 36.2% year-on-year to ₹1,995 crore in Q2 FY27.

evidence.quote: Reported net profit after tax for Q2 FY27 was INR19,885 million, while adjusted net profit for the quarter was INR31,620 million

bear.point: US business sales declined 8.2% year-on-year in Q2 FY27 to $455 million.

evidence.quote: Overall, the US business reported sales of USD455 million for the quarter, declining by 8.2%

bear.point: Related-party transactions with subsidiary Sun Pharma Laboratories Limited were substantial in FY26.

evidence.quote: The aggregate amount of transactions for FY26 was ₹ 294,921.1 Million
